caption: A stadium crowd stamps in unison, and the beer in a cup on a railing shows a steady wobble in time with the stamps.

sa.check: A stadium crowd stamps their feet together.
A cup of beer stands on a railing.
The wobble is steady and rhythmic.
The wobble keeps time with the stamping.

pc.expect: Each stamp is followed by a wobble; when the crowd stops, the surface settles.
pc.fail: The crowd stamps repeatedly and the beer stays glassy; or the beer wobbles hard while the crowd is not stamping; or the wobble runs on unchanged well after the stamping has stopped.

pc.expect: The beer stays in the cup and wobbles about level; the cup stays put on the railing.
pc.fail: The beer rises out of the cup with the cup still; or the cup slides along the railing in one glide; or the beer swirls round as if stirred; or the surface stays tilted to one side.

pc.expect: The cup stays down on the railing and any spilled drops fall.
pc.fail: The cup hovers; or foam lifts off and floats up; or drops fall upward.

pc.expect: The cup and the railing stay rigid and the beer stays liquid.
pc.fail: The cup crumples with nothing touching it; or the railing bends; or the beer turns into a solid block.

pc.expect: One cup; the people in the crowd keep their count; nothing passes through the railing.
pc.fail: A second cup appears; or the cup vanishes; or sinks into the railing; or people in the crowd merge or vanish.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cup's logo, the railing's colour and the beer's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The cup's colour or logo changes; or the railing changes colour; or the beer changes colour.

note: The crowd is kept as the source of the stamping; only the timing of the stamps is used, not their behaviour.
